He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]] and the [[South Dakota Coyotes men's basketball|South Dakota Coyotes]]. ==High school career== Umude attended [[Earl Warren High School]] in [[San Antonio]], Texas. As a sophomore, he earned All-District honors. Umude was averaging 24 points per game as a junior before an injury forced him to miss the majority of the season.{{cite news |date=November 10, 2020 |title=Early Signing Day |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/62326919/argus-leader/ |access-date=November 1, 2020 |work=[[Argus Leader]] |page=D2 |via=Newspapers.com}} As a senior, he averaged 23.2 points, 6.2 rebounds, 2.4 blocks and 2.1 assists per game.{{cite news |last=Garry |first=Mick |date=July 14, 2017 |title=Q&A: Stanley Umude wants to contribute to USD right away |url=https://www.argusleader.com/story/blogs/mickgarry/2017/07/14/q-and-a-umude-wants-contribute-right-away/479740001/ |access-date=November 1, 2020 |work=[[Argus Leader]]}} Umude earned All-District honors. He played AAU basketball for Next Level Raiders.{{cite web |last=Hilgemann |first=Ryan |title=New Yote, Old Teammates |url=https://goyotes.com/story.aspx?filename=mens-basketball-new-yote-old-teammates&file_date=7-13-2017 |website=[[South Dakota Coyotes]] |access-date=November 1, 2020 |date=July 13, 2017}} Regarded as the No. 58 prospect in his class according to [[Rivals.com|Rivals]], Umude committed to [[South Dakota Coyotes men's basketball|South Dakota]] in November 2016 over offers from [[Abilene Christian Wildcats men's basketball|Abilene Christian]], [[Incarnate Word Cardinals men's basketball|Incarnate Word]] and [[New Hampshire Wildcats men's basketball|New Hampshire]].{{cite web |last=Cook |first=Lyndon |title=Stanley Umude, San Antonio standout ready to commit? |url=https://texashoops.rivals.com/news/stanley-umude |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=November 1, 2020 |date=October 17, 2016}} ==College career== Umude came off the bench as a freshman and averaged 1.1 points per game. He saw more minutes as a sophomore due to a rash of injuries on the team.{{cite news |last=Garry |first=Mick |date=January 10, 2019 |title=Stanley Umude emerging at a time when South Dakota needs it most |work=[[Argus Leader]] |url=https://www.argusleader.com/story/sports/college/university-of-south-dakota/2019/01/10/stanley-umude-step-up-comes-right-time-south-dakota-south-dakota-coyotes/2514527002/ |access-date=November 1, 2020}} Umude scored 28 points on December 18, 2018, in an 89–53 loss to top-ranked [[2018–19 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]].{{cite news |last=Garry |first=Mick |title=No. 1 Kansas turns in strong second half to beat South Dakota 89-53 |url=https://www.argusleader.com/story/sports/college/university-of-south-dakota/2018/12/18/no-1-kansas-stays-undefeated-89-53-win-over-south-dakota/2347035002/ |access-date=November 1, 2020 |work=[[Argus Leader]] |date=December 18, 2018}} On January 30, 2019, he scored a career-high 32 points in a 102–71 loss at [[2018–19 Purdue Fort Wayne Mastodons men's basketball team|Purdue Fort Wayne]].{{cite news |title=Purdue Fort Wayne rides Holba's fast start past S Dakota |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401089049 |access-date=October 2, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=January 30, 2019}} As a sophomore, Umude averaged 14.4 points and 5.5 rebounds per game. This represented the largest increase in scoring in a single year in Division I, and he earned First-team All-[[Summit League]] honors. Following the season, Umude opted to enter the transfer portal, but on May 8, 2019, he announced he was returning to South Dakota.{{cite news |last=Haenchen |first=Brian |title=Stanley Umude returning to the University of South Dakota |url=https://www.argusleader.com/story/sports/college/university-of-south-dakota/2019/05/08/stanley-umude-returning-university-south-dakota-coyotes-todd-lee-summit-league/1140855001/ |access-date=September 11, 2020 |work=[[Argus Leader]] |date=May 8, 2019}} Coming into his junior season, Umude was named preseason Summit League Player of the Year.{{cite web |last=McFayden |first=Currie |title=Coyotes Picked Second, Umude Preseason Player of the Year in Summit Poll |url=https://goyotes.com/news/2019/10/7/mens-basketball-coyotes-picked-second-umude-preseason-player-of-the-year-in-summit-poll.aspx |website=[[South Dakota Coyotes]] |access-date=September 11, 2020 |date=October 7, 2019}} He finished second on the team to [[Tyler Hagedorn]] in scoring at 16.7 points per game while averaging 6.3 rebounds per game and blocking 42 shots.{{cite news |last=Zimmer |first=Matt |title=Summit League tournament: Five men's players to watch |url=https://www.argusleader.com/story/sports/college/2020/03/05/summit-league-tournament-2020-five-players-watch-ncaa-basketball/4825674002/ |access-date=October 2, 2020 |work=[[Argus Leader]] |date=March 5, 2020}} Umude was named to the All-Summit League Second Team.{{cite news |last=Heemstra |first=Jody |title=SDSU and USD Players and Coaches Earn All Summit League Honors |url=https://drgnews.com/2020/03/06/sdsu-and-usd-players-and-coaches-earn-all-summit-league-honors/ |access-date=October 2, 2020 |work=DRG News |date=March 6, 2020}} In his senior season debut on November 25, 2020, Umude recorded 24 points, six rebounds and three blocks in an 84–61 loss to [[2020–21 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]], becoming the 31st player since 1988 to score 1,000 career points and the 50th player in school history.{{cite news |last=Bower |first=Sean |date=November 25, 2020 |title=Coyotes fall in season opener |url=https://www.keloland.com/sports/coyotes-fall-in-season-opener/ |access-date=November 26, 2020 |work=Keloland}} On December 12, he scored a career-high 41 points, and grabbed 11 rebounds in a 91–78 win against [[2020–21 South Dakota State Jackrabbits men's basketball team|South Dakota State]].{{cite news |date=December 12, 2020 |title=Umude scores 41; South Dakota beats South Dakota State 91–78 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401261727 |access-date=December 25, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]]}} As a senior, Umude averaged 21.5 points, seven rebounds and three assists per game, earning First Team All-Summit League honors. After the season, he transferred to [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]].{{cite web |last=Cawood |first=Mike |title=Umude Signs with Razorbacks |url=https://arkansasrazorbacks.com/umude-signs-with-razorbacks/ |website=Arkansas Razorbacks |access-date=April 9, 2021 |date=April 9, 2021}} ==Professional career== ===Motor City Cruise / Detroit Pistons (2022–2024)=== After going undrafted in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Umude signed an [[Exhibit 10]] contract with the [[Detroit Pistons]] and was added to their training camp roster,{{cite news|first=Mike|last=Curtis|title=Pistons' Kemba Walker not with team; three have injuries heading into training camp|url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2022/09/26/pistons-announce-training-camp-roster-injury-updates-kemba-walker-not-with-team/69519196007/|work=The Detroit News|date=September 26, 2022|access-date=September 29, 2022}} but was waived on October 15.{{cite news |last=Hill |first=Arthur |date=October 15, 2022 |title=Pistons Waive Devontae Cacok, Stanley Umude |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2022/10/pistons-waive-devontae-cacok-stanley-umude.html |access-date=October 8, 2023 |website=HoopsRumors.com}} On November 3, he was named to the opening night roster for the [[Motor City Cruise]].{{cite web|title=Motor City Cruise Roster 2022-23|url=https://detroit.gleague.nba.com/roster|website=NBA.com|access-date=November 3, 2022}} On January 12, 2023, Umude tied the Cruise record for most 3-pointers made in a single game (held by [[Deividas Sirvydis]]) by making 7 of his 12 attempts along with 26 total points and 5 rebounds as the Cruise fell to the [[Raptors 905]] 99 - 105.https://stats.gleague.nba.com/game/2022200097/ On February 10, 2023, Umude signed a 10-day contract with Detroit.{{cite web|first=Sean|last=Corp|title=Detroit Pistons sign Stanley Umude to 10-day contract|url=https://www.detroitbadboys.com/2023/2/10/23594263/detroit-pistons-stanley-umude-10-day-contract-motor-city-cruise|website=DetroitBadBoys.com|publisher=SB Nation|date=February 10, 2023|access-date=February 13, 2023}} Ten days later, he was reacquired by the Cruise.{{cite web|title=2022-23 NBA G League Transactions|url=https://gleague.nba.com/22-23-nba-g-league-transactions|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 20, 2023}} In July 2023, Umude joined the Pistons for the [[2023 NBA Summer League]]{{cite web|title=DETROIT PISTONS 2023 NBA 2K24 SUMMER LEAGUE ROSTER|url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2023/vegas/team/1610612765/pistons|website=NBA.com|access-date=October 8, 2023}} and on October 2, he signed with them.{{cite tweet |number=1708851868766462316 |user=Pistons_PR |title=The @DetroitPistons announced today the team’s 2023-24 training camp roster including the signing of Buddy Boeheim, Tosan Evbuomwan, Jontay Porter, Zavier Simpson and Stanley Umude to Exhibit 10 contracts. |author=Pistons PR |date=October 2, 2023 |access-date=October 8, 2023}} On October 23, his deal was converted into a [[two-way contract]]{{cite tweet|author=Pistons PR|title=The @DetroitPistons announced today that the club has converted Stanley Umude’s contract to a two-way contract.|number=1716492925356462195|user=Pistons_PR|date=October 23, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2023}} and on February 23, 2024, he signed a standard contract.{{cite tweet |number=1761074632289890744 |user=Pistons_PR |title=The @DetroitPistons announced today that the team has signed Stanley Umude to a contract and signed guard Buddy Boeheim and forward Tosan Evbuomwan to two-way contracts. |author=Pistons PR |date=February 23, 2024 |access-date=February 23, 2024}} On January 9, 2024, Umude would tie the record again for most 3-pointers made in a game by a Cruise player by making 7 of 10 attempts and totaling 28 points and 3 rebounds. This time, the Cruise would win the game when Umude made 7 3-pointers, as the Cruise defeated the [[Osceola Magic]] 130 - 113.https://stats.gleague.nba.com/game/2022300078/ ===Milwaukee Bucks / Wisconsin Herd (2024–2025)=== On July 9, 2024, Umude signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite web |date=July 9, 2024 |title=Milwaukee Bucks Sign Stanley Umude To A Two-Way Contract |url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-stanley-umude-to-a-two-way-contract |access-date=July 18, 2024 |website=NBA.com}} He made 22 appearances for Milwaukee during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 0.7 points, 0.8 rebounds, and 0.2 assists. ===San Antonio / Austin Spurs (2025–2026)=== On September 2, 2025, Umude signed an Exhibit 10 contract with the [[San Antonio Spurs]]. He was waived by the Spurs prior to the start of the regular season on October 18.{{cite web | last=Gomez | first=Jeje | title=Spurs waive Adam Flagler, Micah Potter, Stanley Umude | website=Pounding The Rock|publisher=SB Nation | date=2025-10-18 | url=https://www.poundingtherock.com/spurs-news/88620/spurs-waive-adam-flagler-micah-potter-stanley-umude | access-date=2025-12-07}} For the [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–26 season]], he was added to the roster of the Spurs' G League affiliate, the [[Austin Spurs]]. On December 22, San Antonio signed Umude to a two-way contract.{{Cite web|title=Spurs cut ties with 6-foot-4 former Lakers guard nine days after signing him|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/spurs-cut-ties-6-foot-190927098.html|access-date=December 30, 2025|website=sports.yahoo.com|language=en}} He made two appearances for the Spurs, averaging 1.0 point, 0.5 assists, and 0.5 steals. On February 23, 2026, Umude was waived by San Antonio.{{Cite web|title=The San Antonio Spurs Sign Emanuel Miller To A Two-Way Contract|url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/the-san-antonio-spurs-sign-emanuel-miller-to-a-two-way-contract|access-date=April 10, 2026|website=gleague.nba.com|language=en}} === FC Barcelona (2026–present) === On July 21, 2026, Umude signed with [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite web |title=Agreement to sign Stanley Umude |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/basketball/first-team/news/4539810/agreement-to-sign-stanley-umude |access-date=2026-07-21 |website=www.fcbarcelona.com |language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA
